verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed legal services firm covering fintech regulatory, venture, IP, privacy and employment work, not a software platform. Subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any API or event system (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all return 404), so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
